methods.name: Frozen full core
methods.description: Raw input -> frozen normalization -> actual float32 SmallCNN1D forward; ground truth inference reference.

methods.name: Full equivalent wrapper
methods.description: Identical query wrapper, state machine, and continuity checks as ECDR, but always executes full forward to isolate runtime overhead.

methods.name: Exact input replay
methods.description: Bitwise or collision-safe input equality check on canonical preprocessed bytes; singleton cache without regional certificate.

methods.name: Exact incremental computation
methods.description: Reuses unshifted intermediate Conv1D/BN/Pool feature representations; computes full Flatten-MLP head to produce identical output.

methods.name: Heuristic reuse
methods.description: Reuses prior prediction when distance falls within empirical threshold; measures error vs speedup without formal certificate.

methods.name: Global Lipschitz cache
methods.description: Computes certified L2 ball radius r = Delta / (2 * L_global) using 11-margin output bounds and global spectral norm constant.

methods.name: IBP diagonal box
methods.description: Propagates 768-dimensional axis-aligned interval box through actual Conv1D-BN-ReLU-Pool-Flatten-Linear graph; verifies 11 margin specs.

methods.name: IBP fixed-overlap wave
methods.description: Fixed 384-dimensional prefix contract + 384-dimensional tail box; exploits 50% temporal sliding window overlap.

methods.name: Correlated candidate via coordinate hull
methods.description: Ablation control: converts PCA-affine candidate into outer bounding box before interval propagation; measures hull loss.

methods.name: Native correlated bounds
methods.description: Direct zonotope / affine factor propagation preserving linear dependencies across sensor channels and time steps.

methods.name: CROWN diagonal
methods.description: Linear relaxation backward bounding on ambient diagonal coordinate box; evaluates tighter margin lower bounds vs IBP.

methods.name: CROWN wave/correlated
methods.description: CROWN relaxation over transformed wave and affine candidate domains; evaluates bound tightness under temporal constraints.

methods.name: Fixed-anchor policy control
methods.description: Policy axis: uses single immutable anchor throughout lifetime until expiration or boundary discontinuity.

methods.name: Finite-horizon policy control
methods.description: Policy axis: bounds reachable input regions for discrete horizons H in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}; enforces no-drift contract.

methods.name: Faithful LipCache comparator
methods.description: Evaluates LipCache proxy framework (Xiang et al. 2026) under exact published semantics. Audited in W4-029: requires separate GuardNet training (out of frozen scope) and certificate holds only on GuardNet side (Remark 5.2), not MainNet.

methods.name: Prior-work applicability only
methods.description: Formal audit of StreamiNNC (Kechris et al. 2024) and TinyDejaVu (Huang et al. 2026) architectural and runtime prerequisites. Completed in W4-029: excluded from performance ranking.

methods.name: OWNED_REFERENCE baseline
methods.description: Secondary full-forward baseline executed under optimized in-memory ownership profile without redundant integrity hashing per query.
